what: Real, public responses recorded from NEAR AI Cloud (https://cloud-api.near.ai/v1). No key or Authorization header is stored.

report.note: Unmodified response bodies. Fetched before the tool and stream completions below, after the proxied one.

tool.what: Non-streaming tool-call completion by a model NEAR AI hosts in a TEE. Signature kind: provider_tee.

stream.what: Streamed completion by the same model. Signature kind: gateway.

proxied.what: Non-streaming completion by a model proxied to an outside provider. Signature kind: gateway.

bytes: Request and response files are the exact bytes sent and received (no trailing newline added). Do not reformat them.
models: models.json is a 7-model excerpt of GET /v1/models (id, owned_by, pricing, context_length, supported_features).
